title: WATCH AGAIN: President Rinkēvičs at UN Security Council
summary_full: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs is in New York (USA) on Monday to speak at a meeting of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).
summary_public: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs is in New York (USA) on Monday to speak at a meeting of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).
